Proof of (1). Assume that <MATH_0001> and <MATH_0002> are
universally closed. Then <MATH_0003> is separated and universally
closed by
Lemma <REF_0001>.
By
Morphisms of Spaces,
Lemma <REF_0002>
and
Algebraic Stacks,
Lemma <REF_0003>
we see that <MATH_0004> is quasi-compact.
Hence it is quasi-compact, separated, universally closed and locally of
finite type (by
Lemma <REF_0004>)
so proper. This proves ``<MATH_0005>'' of (1).
The proof of the implication in the other direction is omitted.

<STRUCT_0001><STRUCT_0002>
Proof of (2). This follows immediately from
Lemma <REF_0005>.

<STRUCT_0003><STRUCT_0004>
Proof of (3). This follows from the fact that <MATH_0006> is always locally
quasi-finite by
Lemma <REF_0006>
applied to <MATH_0007>.

<STRUCT_0005><STRUCT_0006>
Proof of (4). This follows from the fact that <MATH_0008> is always
unramified as
Lemma <REF_0007>
applied to <MATH_0009> shows that
<MATH_0010> is locally of finite type and a monomorphism.
See
More on Morphisms of Spaces,
Lemma <REF_0008>.
